1. (Currently amended) A method for content optimization, comprising: receiving a rule on probability factor, the rule on probability factor specifying a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a particular value of a selected content attribute; generating a plurality of pieces of content in accordance with the rule on probability factor __using machine learning algorithms to automatically vary content parameters__; collecting content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content when the plurality of pieces of content are in use __through real-time user interaction monitoring__; determining, by a processor, an aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute having the particular value based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __wherein the aggregated performance data comprises conversion rates and user engagement metrics__; and modifying, by the processor, the rule on probability factor based on the aggregated performance data __to dynamically optimize future content generation__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a size or position adjustment, or an attribute of a transition __and wherein the content attribute is automatically selected based on performance impact analysis__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: determining, by the processor, a deviation value for aggregated performance data the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __using statistical variance calculations__, wherein the modifying step comprises modifying the rule on probability factor based on both the aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute __to account for performance variability__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: receiving a set of rules for content generation __comprising predefined content templates and formatting specifications__; identifying a changeable content attribute based on the set of rules for content generation __through automated rule analysis__; and composing, by the processor, one or more rules on probability factor for the changeable content attribute __using adaptive probability distribution algorithms__.

8. (Currently amended) A content optimization system, comprising: a rule management module maintaining a set of rules for content generation, the set of rules comprising a rule on probability factor, the rule on probability factor specifying a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a particular value of a selected content attribute __wherein the rule management module implements machine learning-based rule optimization__; a content generation module operative to generate a plurality of pieces of content based on the set of rules, the plurality of pieces of content designed with a particular optimization objective __using automated content variation algorithms__; and a content evaluation module operative to evaluate content performance on reaching the particular optimization objective based on data acquired when the plurality of pieces of content are displayed __through real-time performance tracking__, wherein the content evaluation module is further operative to determine an aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute having the particular value based on the evaluated content performance __comprising conversion metrics and user engagement data__, wherein the rule management module is operative to amend the rule on probability factor based on the aggregated content performance data __using dynamic probability adjustment algorithms__.

9. (Currently amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a metric adjustment, or an attribute of a transition __and wherein the attribute is automatically identified through performance impact analysis__.

10. (Currently amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the content evaluation module is further operative to determine a deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __using statistical variance calculations__, and wherein the rule management module is further operative to modify the rule on probability factor based on both the aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute __to optimize for performance consistency__.

11. (Currently amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the rule management module is further operative to identify a changeable content attribute based on the set of rules for content generation __through automated rule analysis algorithms__ and compose a rule on probability factor for the changeable content attribute __using adaptive probability distribution methods__.

13. (Currently amended) A method comprising: receiving a first rule on probability factor and a second rule on probability factor, the first rule on probability factor defining a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a first value of a selected content attribute, the second rule on probability factor defining a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a second value of the selected content attribute, the second value being different from the first value __wherein the rules are generated using machine learning algorithms__; generating a plurality of pieces of content in accordance with the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor __using automated content variation systems__; collecting content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content when the plurality of pieces of content are in use __through real-time user interaction monitoring__; determining, by a processor, a first aggregated performance data for the first value of the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __comprising conversion rates and engagement metrics__; determining, by a processor, a second aggregated performance data for the second value of the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __comprising conversion rates and engagement metrics__; and modifying, by the processor, the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor based on both the first aggregated performance data and the second aggregated performance data __using dynamic probability optimization algorithms__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a metric adjustment, or an attribute of a transition __and wherein the attribute is automatically selected based on performance impact analysis__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising: determining, by the processor, a deviation value for the first aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __using statistical variance calculations__, wherein the modifying step comprises modifying the first rule on probability factor based on both the first aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the first aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute __to account for performance variability__.
